briefings.title: HHS Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. Testifies on Budget

people.name: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
people.role: U.S. Secretary of Health and Human Services

briefings.tldr: Secretary Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. presented a 2027 budget centered on the "Make America Healthy Again" (MAHA) initiative, prioritizing the reversal of the chronic disease epidemic through nutrition reform and drug price transparency while facing sharp criticism over his skepticism of vaccine efficacy and the management of recent measles outbreaks.
